lines.en: label wakanadate25p3:
scene wakanatreatsyou1
After a fair bit of walking and a great deal of being told where to go, the two of us make it to a rather...purple looking restaurant.
And not a moment too late, as I was only a block or two from tossing Wakana into the river to never be heard from again.
In fact, the only reason I didn’t do such a thing is that I didn’t want to be bothered actually navigating to it.
Though, I suppose there’s the element of a free dinner that I was looking forward to as well.
But either way, we’re here now and I no longer have to deal with the tyranny that is backseat driver, Wakana Watabe.
And yes, it is possible to be a backseat driver when the seat is literally someone’s back.
And yes, it is just as annoying as it sounds.
: Is something wrong again, Arakawa? What did I do to piss you off this time?
: This time isn’t serious. I just think you need to be a little more considerate when someone is carrying you around. You were very bossy back there.
: Aww...did I hurt your feelings? Does it make you feel weak not being in charge of every facet of everyone’s life at every point ever?
: Wakana, I was literally carrying you.
: And you could have done a better job. That is all I’m saying.
scene wakanatreatsyou2
: But we made it here. And I suppose that’s all that really matters.
: Until you have to find another human taxi once we’re done eating. Also, where is here? And since when does something like this exist in Kumon-mi?
: This place has existed forever. You likely just haven’t stumbled upon it because you’re an overly-sensitive manchild who spends his free time eating at maid cafes and hitting on teenagers.
: Only because it’s impossible to do that first thing without doing the second thing in the process.
: It is very much possible to visit a maid cafe without being a pervert, Arakawa.
: Well, it isn’t possible for me. And the food there is surprisingly good.
: That’s just not the reason you go.
: Exactly.
scene wakanatreatsyou3
: This place has been a favorite spot of mine since college. I’ve come here with Osako on many occasions. We even had our first date here.
: And now I get to have the pleasure of being wined and dined by you in the same building where you formed a lifelong partnership? Wow. Maybe we really are friends after all?
: I’m glad to see my decision to share a bit of sentimentality with you is paying off in spades. Just don’t mention we came here to Osako or she’ll likely assume we’re sleeping together.
: That said, is it actually okay for me to be here? You could have just taken me to a McDonald’s or something.
scene wakanatreatsyou4
: We’re here because I want to be here. Not because you actually mean something to me.
: That’s fine. Just make sure to give me a five-star review for the ride. It’ll look good on my profile.
: Did you know you’re the first person I’ve ever brought here besides Osako?

: No. But that’s mostly due to the fact that the only things I know about you are that you’re into BDSM and that your back is fucked up. Which, thinking about it now, isn’t the safest combination of things.
: I’ve managed so far. Albeit with a great deal of help from the medical field.
: But what I’m trying to allude to in telling you this seemingly unimportant fact is that this gesture is meant to make you smile.
: If you even know how, that is.
: I don’t.
: I’m glad to see you do, though.
: You’ve been doing that a lot lately, come to think of it.
scene wakanatreatsyou5
: It’s almost like getting to know someone means you can show them sides of yourself you don’t typically show others.
: Yeah. But only almost. I’m still going to keep everything hidden forever because it makes life easier.
: If your life is so easy, why do your eyes begin to glisten each time I bring up a certain extremely controversial poet?
: My eyes are always glistening. I am simply that beautiful. But not nearly as beautiful as-
: Don’t even think about it.
: My bad. The whole “being out on a date at an important restaurant” thing must be getting to me.
: This is not a date, Arakawa. This is two gloomy and sarcastic friends escaping the grind that is a life dedicated to sculpting the minds of youth. Or, in your case, destroying them.
: Hey, that’s still sculpting. Just in reverse.
: You disgust me.
: Then why are you still smiling?
: Because you’ve forgiven me. And I’m glad that we’re back on track.
: Who says I’ve forgiven you?
: You do. Just not directly. But your actions and your attitude tell me that I have crawled my way out of the doghouse and back into your top eight.
: Top eight?
scene wakanatreatsyou6
: Wait, Arakawa — how old are you again?
: Did you...not have a Myspace account growing up?
: Is that a social media thing?
: It is, yes. Or...was. Or technically still is. But mostly just was.
: Then, no. I was never into that sort of thing.
: Wow, you really are the most dull person to ever walk the face of the Earth, aren’t you?
: I guess so. But it’s not like you’re all that far ahead of me, little Miss “Private school.”
scene wakanatreatsyou7
: Woe is me. I’m being teased for receiving a proper education and coming from an affluent background. Oh, how will I ever recover from this?
: Actually, yeah. Hold on. If you come from an affluent background, why are you living in a one bedroom apartment with a girl who works two jobs?
scene wakanatreatsyou8
: Arakawa, this may come as a big surprise to you, so brace yourself- but there are people in this world who are too proud to accept aid from others and would much rather get by on their own terms.
: When Osako and I first decided to start living together, we agreed to be among those people. We agreed that we’d survive off of our own money rather than rely on my parents.
: Because life is more fulfilling that way.
: Additionally, relying on someone to that extent means you have the potential to be monumentally fucked if they pull the rug out from underneath you.
: And if I am going to be monumentally fucked by anyone, I’d prefer it to be my partner rather than my parents.
: That’s kind of admirable, actually. I wish I had that kind of willpower.

: I wish you had any amount of willpower so you could come to understand that your insistence on nibbling at forbidden fruit is completely asinine and that you are squandering a wonderful opportunity.
: Wait, what? Are we changing topics?
: No. At the moment, we are on the topic of love. And seeing as my love is strong and my loyalty is unflappable, it is time for me to, once again, take a moment or two to ridicule you.
: What happened to smiley Wakana? I want her back.
: No. You asked me a question about my personal life, so it’s only fair that I now pry into yours as if my words are the jaws of life and your thoughts are-
: Choose a different simile.
scene wakanatreatsyou9
scene wakanatreatsyou10
: Apologies. I...didn’t realize that was-
: Anyway, what I meant to say is that this dinner means nothing if all we discuss is me. Relationships go both ways and-
: Yours doesn’t.
scene wakanatreatsyou11
: Was...Was that a lesbian joke?
: Yeah. Just moving right along. No time for any more depressing stuff right now.
: You do know I’m attracted to men as well, correct?
: Yeah. But I also know that Osako isn’t. Which makes my joke both valid and hilarious.
: While it’s cute to see your sense of humor is no more mature than the girls who fill your classroom, I would like to move on now.
: My bad. Go ahead.
scene wakanatreatsyou12
: Arakawa, I am going to be straight with you right now.
: Get your facts in order, Wakana. You were bi just a second ago.
scene wakanatreatsyou13
: Pfft!
: Are...Are you actually-
scene wakanatreatsyou14
: No.
: I am going to be direct with you right now because this matter concerns me on a number of levels and, as the most successful person you know in the world of romance, you should follow my lead.
: By doing what exactly?
: By cutting down the hopes and dreams of twenty hormonal teenagers who think they’re in love with you because you’re the only creature within a fifty mile radius who has a penis.
: Wakana-
: And by opening your god damn eyes and seeing what’s right in front of you.
: What’s right in front of me is a woman who’s already in a committed relationship. And Osako would-
scene wakanatreatsyou15
: Not me, you fucking idiot. Imani.
: You too?
: What do you mean, “me too?” Who else have you talked to about this?
: Rika. And I’ll tell you the same thing I told her. I care about Imani. Like...way more than I ever expected to.
scene wakanatreatsyou16
: Then why-
: That is why.
: I’m not following, Arakawa. Please channel all of the primitive power in your simian brain and explain this to me in a way that a normal human being would be able to understand.
scene wakanatreatsyou17
: Imani is a great match for me. Everyone knows that. And if I were a normal person, I’d jump at the opportunity to be with her.
: But I’m not a normal person.
: And I can’t be with her in a way that would make her happy.
: She’d grow to resent me when she realizes that I’m not who she thinks I am. And eventually, she’d start blaming herself for not seeing that in the first place.
: She’s strong and independent and all that, so I don’t want to say it would screw her up for good when I think she’d be fine after a little while.
: But I wouldn’t. I don’t have anyone else like her in my life.
: There’s you, yeah. But you’re different. Imani’s like...a little sister or something. Just she’s a completely different race than me and I also want to have earth-shattering sex with her.
: I’m just not the right person for her. If it was purely physical, I’d be able to look past it. But I think that ship has sailed. And I don’t want to lead her on.
: Is that enough? Can we go back to talking about you and your sexual orientation again?
scene wakanatreatsyou18
: Hah...Of course the one thing you’d be mature about is the one thing that will wind up hurting someone else who’s close to me.
: I’d only hurt her more if I took your advice.
: I know. You’re right. Which is why I’m not arguing with you and why I am hereby retiring as her wingwoman. I just feel bad for the poor girl as she’s quite smitten for some ungodly reason.
: Yeah. People just kind of fall for me like that. Maybe it really is the penis thing after all?
scene wakanatreatsyou19
: On that note, how the absolute fuck did you wind up bagging an idol? And Kumon-mi’s darling, no less.
: She’s my childhood friend. And the first girlfriend I ever had. And also maybe the last? It’s kind of complicated.
: So...wait. I know I just said I’d drop this, but now I’m confused.

: You won’t be with Imani because you care too much about the prospect of harming her. But you will be with your childhood friend and ex-girlfriend, who plays a much more significant role in your life?
: Are you just...okay with hurting her?
: No.
: I’m just in love with her.
scene wakanatreatsyou20
: Hah...
: This is why I’ve never dated a man. You’re all stupid. You could have just said that and put an immediate end to the Imani situation without having to go into such detail.
: You wanted me to talk, so I talked. This is your fault.
scene wakanatreatsyou1
: So the beast can feel love after all.
: I’m not sure how I feel about being called a “beast.”

: Apologies for my hesitance in calling you “human.” I just have a hard time believing you actually are one after how long I had to listen to your childhood friend cry out in pleasure the other night.
: Yeah...sorry about that. And also, sorry for her trying to rope you two into it.
scene wakanatreatsyou20
: My one chance to sleep with a celebrity...squandered by moral obligations and my previously mentioned unflappable loyalty.
: You do realize I would have been involved too, right?
scene wakanatreatsyou3
: It’s not unusual for there to be a little suffering on the way to making your dreams come true. Your inclusion would simply be me “taking one for the team.”
: Unfortunately for all of us, Osako matters to me far too much to do something like that. So I will put her best interests at heart and just pretend none of it ever happened.
: But...just to clarify, you’d be okay with it?
scene wakanatreatsyou9
: With what? Having a threesome with an extraordinarily attractive celebrity? Of course I’d be okay with it. That’s a once in a lifetime opportunity.
: You don’t think that interferes with your love or anything?
: I am of the opinion that true love is letting your significant other have sex with a celebrity because, again, come on.
scene wakanatreatsyou7
: But...that is not how Osako thinks. And her thoughts and feelings are just as important as mine. If not even more important.
: Regardless — I thank your childhood friend for the offer, congratulate you on being human enough to love someone, and pity Imani more than I already have been for her despicable taste in men.
: Busy night for you, huh? This is probably the most you’ve had to think since college.
: That’s not true at all. My mind was absolutely flooded by complicated thoughts after that one time I overdosed and wound up in the hospital while you completely ignored my existence.
: Wakana, it’s been years. It’s time to move past that.
: It’s not been years, Arakawa. Years would imply that-
scene wakanatreatsyou21
: Wakana?
: Are you-
: Shh. I’m thinking.
scene wakanatreatsyou22
: Are you familiar with Ecclesiastes 3:1-8?
scene black
